_note: DATA. This file may only ADD to the code-level floor in engine/schema.js (REQUIRED_SECTIONS, REQUIRED_LAB_FIELDS, FORBIDDEN_CURRENT_KEYS). The floor lives in CODE precisely so that deleting or emptying this file cannot disarm the gate — the same shape, and the same reason, as skills/preanalytical-guard/registry/universal.json. The loader unions the two sets and asserts the union still contains every floor entry.
_forbidden_preanalytical_slots_source: skills/preanalytical-guard/engine/conditions.js :: SLOTS — the per-draw sampling-condition bundle that skill owns. case-state's `preanalytical_context` carries DATED history facts (a sustained fast, a training block), never per-draw slots; a slot name appearing here would be a SECOND answer to a question another skill already answers. The two lists are NOT imported from one another — a cross-skill require() resolves in the repo and breaks after install (04_domain_model.md M-5) — so their agreement is asserted by test/case-state-profile-validate.test.js with a non-empty positive control, exactly as ADR-005 §5 declares a divergence rather than assuming coherence.
